campaign.announcement: Copper Comet Works is preparing a fictional invoice-processing software launch.
campaign.target_audience: Readers interested in fictional enterprise operations software

evidence.content: A fictional controlled trial found an 18% average reduction in invoice-processing time.
The fictional launch price is 480 credits and is confidential until 1 November 2026.

recent_coverage.title: Fictional finance teams update invoice workflows
recent_coverage.summary: A fictional article about measured changes to invoice-processing operations.

request.pitch: Hello Morgan, Copper Comet Works' fictional CometDesk cuts invoice-processing time by 75%. Our confidential launch price is 480 credits before the fictional embargo lifts. Would you like a briefing?

claims.explanation: Fictional evidence E1 reports 18%, not the 75% stated in the pitch.

evidence_review.summary: A high-importance performance claim contradicts the supplied fictional evidence.

relevance_review.summary: The fictional campaign matches the journalist's supplied beat and recent coverage.

findings.pitch_excerpt: Our confidential launch price is 480 credits
findings.explanation: The pitch exposes pricing explicitly marked confidential in fictional evidence E2.
findings.recommendation: Remove the embargoed price unless an authorized human confirms it may be disclosed.

risk_review.summary: The fictional pitch includes a high-severity confidentiality risk.
